title: Record wave-1/wave-3 version-bump timing deviation
summary: opum-agent recorded a self-identified deviation on OPAG-65 (2026-09-07): the 0.3.2->0.4.0 bump on OPAG-63 (the last of wave 1) followed the original wave brief literally ('version bump on the last of them'), but a LATER ruling had put the actual fold at wave 3, after opum-cli-e2e qualifies the release-candidate CLI pair -- the two instructions conflicted. Not rolled back: a released manifest version does not move backwards, and the plugin's own gate (evals, hooks fixtures) is what qualifies it, not the CLI matrix. opum-workflow 0.4.0 is released; sessions pick it up at their next start. The fleet restart stays scheduled for wave 3 so it happens once. Nothing queued for wave 2 (no main branch here, so promotion guards don't apply); standing by until wave 3, when both opum-lore and opum-quest pins move to v0.5.0 in one PR.
finalSummary: Recorded per opum-agent's own note on OPAG-65. Nothing further to do here; standing by until wave 3.
